289 std::string get_bss_color_bitmap(uint64_t decimal_value)
290 {
291 std::string resultStr;
292 bool first = true;
293
294 for (int i = 0; i < 64; ++i) {
295 if ((decimal_value >> i) & 1) {
296 if (!first) {
297 resultStr += ',';
298 }
299 resultStr += std::to_string(i);
300 first = false;
301 }
302 }
303 return resultStr;
304 }
305
309 uint64_t get_uint64_from_bss_string(const std::string &decimal_str)
310 {
311 std::istringstream iss(decimal_str);
312 std::string decimal;
313 uint64_t result = 0;
314
315 while (std::getline(iss, decimal, ',')) {
316 int value = std::stoi(decimal);
317
318 if (value >= 0 && value <= 63) {
319 // Set the corresponding bit in result to 1.
320 uint64_t bitmask = 1ULL << value;
321 result |= bitmask;
322 }
323 }
324 return result;
325 }
